newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc Q4 net, share rise.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc Q4 net, share rise.

text.p: (a) Pro forma results prepared as if acquisitions of Fisons plc FISN.L and Applied Immune Sciences Inc AISX.O and the formation of the Centeon joint venture had occurred January 1, 1995 and include adjustments for financing charges and amortization.

(b) Other charges reflects pretax charges of $102.6 million ($0.50 per share) related to the reassessments of certain intangible and fixed asset carrying values associated with the ex-vivo cell processing initiatives of Applied Immune Sciences Inc.

(c) Gain on sales of assets for the quarter and year ended December 31, 1996, includes pretax gains of $81.5 million ($0.35 per share) on the sales of certain nonstrategic European self-medication product rights and pretax gains of $29.2 million ($0.16 per share) on the sales of other nonstrategic assets in France and Belgium.
In 1995, pretax gains on the sales of the company's Canadian over-the-counter business and certain European product rights totaled $49.5 million ($0.25 per share).

(d) Income from equity affiliates, including the company's interest in the Centeon joint venture, totaled $5.5 million and $83.0 million for quarter and year ended December 31, 1996. Full-year 1996 equity income includes charges of $44.0 million ($0.20 per share) for estimated impact of Centeon's voluntary recall of all in-date lots of albumin products sold under the trademarks Albuminar and Plasma Plex.

(e) Other (income) -- net for the three and twelve months ended 1995 includes income from equity affiliates totaling $50.4 million and $177.7 million, respectively. Other (income) -- net for full year 1995 also includes charges of $25.4 million ($0.15 per share) from reassessment of certain asset carrying values.

(f) Earnings per common share for twelve-month pro forma 1995 include effect of pro forma charges totaling $1.6 million related to acquisitions of Cooperation Pharmaceutique Francaise and Rhodia Farma from Rhone-Poulenc S.A.
